title: 3D HYBE CHEERING PARTY (HCF 2026)
synopsis:
Broadway Cinemas exclusively presents HYBE CINE FEST 2026 ! bringing your favorite HYBE’s artists to the big screen! Featureing SEVENTEEN, ENHYPEN, TXT and BTS!  EVERYWHERE, WE CHEER!

 

The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!
